title: Verniman method: auction, order flow and execution knowledge base
summary: A source-backed Markdown knowledge base covering 27 selected blog topics, reviewed video captions, chart readings, level roles, terminology and unresolved implementation details.
data_summary: 27 blog pages captured; 46 embedded videos inventoried; 42 caption exports fully read, including one unreliable export; six source market charts and one slide inspected. No market dataset calculations.
evidence_status: Qualitative external source research only. Four videos have no retained transcript; auto-caption and static-image limits remain explicit. No Abacus backtest, strategy implementation or profitability validation.
